title: Everyday Phrases — First Day of School
scene_zh: 開學第一天 · 情境對話
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🎒 實用開學第一天必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — First Day of School
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用開學第一天情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從前一晚收書包、列文具清單、等校車，到找教室、認課表、自我介紹、發新書、舉手發言、食堂排隊，最後放學回家講今天、排好明天的東西安心入睡。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical First Day of School phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), from packing the bag the night before, finding your classroom and reading the timetable, to new books, class rules, the canteen line and telling family all about it at home. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow is your first day.
dialogue.zh: 明天就是你開學的第一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can't believe it's already here.
dialogue.zh: 真不敢相信已經到這天了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's pack your bag tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚先把書包收拾好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll get my backpack.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is your backpack clean and dry?
dialogue.zh: 你的背包乾淨又乾爽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I wiped it last night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put your pencils in the case.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have three sharp ones here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need a new ruler?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, my old one still works.
dialogue.zh: 不用，我舊的那支還能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count the notebooks for me.
dialogue.zh: 幫我數數筆記本有幾本。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four, I just counted them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four will be enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can add more later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is your eraser?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's under my bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Find it before we finish.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, it was by my shoe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt, ɪt wʌz baɪ maɪ ʃu./
dialogue.zh: 找到了，原本在我的鞋子旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How about glue and scissors?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the list has both.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's the school supply list.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me read it with you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crayons are on the list.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I still have a full box.
dialogue.zh: 我還有整整一盒沒用完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You need a folder for papers.
dialogue.zh: 你還需要一個資料夾放紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue one is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write your name inside it.
dialogue.zh: 在夾子裡面寫上你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll use my good pen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is your uniform ready?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's laid out, all set.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try the shirt on once more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fits, and it's not tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your shoes must be black.
dialogue.zh: 你的鞋子必須是黑色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I polished them after dinner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fill your water bottle tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cold one is in the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə koʊld wʌn ɪz ɪn ðə frɪdʒ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pack a snack for tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An apple and some crackers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time does school start?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The paper says eight forty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bus comes before that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight fifteen, at our corner.
dialogue.zh: 八點十五，就在我們路口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we must be up at seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi mʌst bi ʌp ət ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 所以我們七點就得起床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is way too early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll set two alarms.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put mine by the lamp.
dialogue.zh: 把我的那個放在台燈旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lay out your socks tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The thick ones keep me warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It might rain tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I bring my raincoat?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, fold it into your bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll take an umbrella too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your snack box goes in first.
dialogue.zh: 你的零食盒要最先放進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The apple can stay on top.
dialogue.zh: 蘋果就可以擺在最上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does everything fit in the end?
dialogue.zh: 最後全部東西都裝得下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the zipper still closes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, your bag is done.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, I need one more thing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is still missing?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My lucky green pencil.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Find it, then zip up.
dialogue.zh: 找到以後把拉鍊拉起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, can I read a book?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt, kæn aɪ rid ə bʊk?/
dialogue.zh: 找到了！我可以看本書嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bedtime is nine thirty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I won't read too late.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lie down and rest your legs.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My tummy feels funny.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's just first-day nerves.
dialogue.zh: 那只是第一天的緊張感。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does everyone feel that way?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even big kids feel it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Will the other kids notice?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody will look that close.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, that helps a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close your eyes real slow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I kept thinking about tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thinking about what, tell me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If anyone will talk to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smile first, they usually do.
dialogue.zh: 你先微笑，他們通常就會回應。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That sounds like a good plan.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breathe in, then breathe out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this, nice and slow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your hands can rest now.
dialogue.zh: 你的雙手現在可以放鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They were cold a minute ago.
dialogue.zh: 一分鐘前它們還冷冷的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I pulled the blanket up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, that is warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep now, tomorrow is yours.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But I don't feel sleepy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try counting to ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I counted to twelve instead.
dialogue.zh: 我反而一路數到十二去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count sheep crossing the fence.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten sheep, maybe fifteen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See, your voice got soft.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Am I still talking?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little, and that's fine.
dialogue.zh: 還有一點點，這樣沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm used to the dark now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The whole house is quiet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bus will be loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loud is fun on day one.
dialogue.zh: 第一天吵一點反而有趣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope it comes on time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll wake you up first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, now I can rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wake up, the sun is out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five more minutes, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No time, the bus is close.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, my feet are down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wash your face and brush fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold water woke me up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your uniform is on the chair.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's right where you left it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breakfast is toast and eggs.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can eat half of mine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take the rest in your bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, I'll be hungry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's a juice for the road.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, I'll save it for later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have your supply list?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It folds into my pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's walk to the corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My bag feels heavy already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's the bus, yellow and big.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stopped right in front of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɑpt raɪt ɪn frʌnt əv ʌs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show the driver your pass.
dialogue.zh: 把你的乘車證給司機看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He smiled and said hi.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit where you can see out.
dialogue.zh: 坐在可以看到外面的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This window seat is perfect.
dialogue.zh: 這個靠窗的位置太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The school looks so big.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see ten doors, maybe more.
dialogue.zh: 我看到十扇門，也許更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Follow the line of kids.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bell already rang once.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're at the front gate now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says room one two three.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way is the first floor?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me ask that helper.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lady in the green vest.
dialogue.zh: 就是穿綠色背心的那位女士。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Excuse me, where is my room?
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，我的教室在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She said walk on, then turn left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛd wɔk ɑn, ðɛn tɜrn lɛft./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At the library or the gym?
dialogue.zh: 是在圖書館那邊還是體育館？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before the library, by the gym.
dialogue.zh: 在圖書館前面，體育館旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now I know the way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look for the red sign.
dialogue.zh: 找找看那個紅色的牌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I found it, here we are!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read the name on the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's my name up there!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The timetable is on the wall.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll look for math class.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Math is first today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Reading is right after math.
dialogue.zh: 閱讀課就接在數學後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Art is last today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I like drawing, so it's great.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your desk has a small tag.
dialogue.zh: 你的桌上有一個小標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Row three, seat two is mine.
dialogue.zh: 第三排第二個座位是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lift the lid and look in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's clean and empty inside.
dialogue.zh: 裡面很乾淨，什麼都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hang your bag on the hook.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's up nice and high.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit down and wait a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chair next to me is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃɛr nɛkst tu mi ɪz fri./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A girl just looked at you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll wave, is that okay?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wave and say your name.
dialogue.zh: 揮手之後說出你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I did, and she waved back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's her name?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her name is Lily, she's new.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Were you both new today?
dialogue.zh: 你們倆今天都是新生嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we sat in the same row.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wi sæt ɪn ðə seɪm roʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many kids in your class?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I counted nineteen at my seat.
dialogue.zh: 我坐在位子上數到十九。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nineteen is a good size.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone has room to sit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The door opened, is that her?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just a teacher passing by.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep your hands on the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I was tapping, sorry about that.
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛在敲桌子，不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tapping is fine, keep quiet though.
dialogue.zh: 輕輕敲沒關係，但要安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll wiggle my toes instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here comes your teacher now.
dialogue.zh: 你的老師現在走進來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She smiles, that's a good sign.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stand when she says hello.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We all stood and said it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɔl stʊd ənd sɛd ɪt bæk./
dialogue.zh: 我們全部站起來回問早安。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She wrote her name up big.
dialogue.zh: 她在黑板上寫了大大的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Miss Parker, I like that.
dialogue.zh: 帕克老師，我喜歡這個名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She asked each kid one thing.
dialogue.zh: 她要每個小朋友說一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My turn came so fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did you tell them?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I said I like bikes and art.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɛd aɪ laɪk baɪks ənd ɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 我說我喜歡騎車和畫圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the class laugh at you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They laughed in a nice way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That kind of laugh is warm.
dialogue.zh: 那種笑聲其實是溫暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now I don't feel so small.
dialogue.zh: 我不會覺得自己很渺小了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You did great, come sit down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My voice was very tiny.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tiny is fine, they heard you.
dialogue.zh: 小聲沒關係，他們聽見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll be louder tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This map shows the whole school.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where's the office on it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next to the big blue doors.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the nurse, which floor?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First floor, right at the end.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I'll remember that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bell says class is done.
dialogue.zh: 鐘聲表示這節課結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Line up now for the next one.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪn ʌp naʊ fər ðə nɛkst wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now your reading class starts.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one has books and songs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit on the round gray mat.
dialogue.zh: 坐在圓圓的灰色墊子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The books are in a pile.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She is handing out new ones.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine smells like fresh paper.
dialogue.zh: 我這本聞起來有紙的清香。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write your name on the front.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I used the sticker she gave.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not bend the cover.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will keep it flat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the page very slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The first story has many pictures.
dialogue.zh: 第一篇故事有很多插圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read one line out loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I read three lines, not one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was the hard word long?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she helped me say it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the class rules came out.
dialogue.zh: 接著老師拿出班級規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are five on the poster.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the very first one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen when someone is talking.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The second rule is easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep your hands to yourself.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And what about walking inside?
dialogue.zh: 在室內走路是怎麼說的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We walk, we never run here.
dialogue.zh: 在裡面只用走的，不可以跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What else does the poster say?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can always ask for help.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以隨時請求幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The last one is about kindness.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Be kind to everyone, every day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do we ask a question?
dialogue.zh: 我們想問問題的話該怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Raise your hand and wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you raise yours today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice, and she picked me once.
dialogue.zh: 舉了兩次，她點了我一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did you ask her?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I asked where the coats go.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you find your hook?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one with my name on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʌn wɪθ maɪ neɪm ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 就是貼了我名字的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any other hands went up?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A boy asked for a pencil.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she let him borrow one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, from the shared box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you know the shared box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glue, tape and spare pens live there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlu, teɪp ənd spɛr pɛnz lɪv ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 膠水、膠帶和備用筆都在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the lid back on.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I always do that, don't worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the long bell rang.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that the break or lunch?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one is break time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I need the bathroom first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you know where it is?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Down the hall, by the water cooler.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn ðə hɔl, baɪ ðə ˈwɔtər ˈkulər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Push the door and go in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There was a line of kids.
dialogue.zh: 前面已經排了一串小朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait your turn, no noise.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I stood behind the tall boy.
dialogue.zh: 我站在那個高個男生後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wash your hands after.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The soap smelled like apples.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you dry them on your shirt?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju draɪ ðɛm ɑn jʊr ʃɜrt?/
dialogue.zh: 你有把手擦在衣服上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I used a paper towel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go outside before the bell.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I jumped rope with Lily.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you win the jumping game?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We took turns, nobody won.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lunch bell came next.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My tummy growled right then.
dialogue.zh: 我的肚子剛好在那時叫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Get in the lunch line.
dialogue.zh: 到打午餐的隊伍裡排好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The line went around the corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold your tray with both hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I got milk and a warm roll.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɑt mɪlk ənd ə wɔrm roʊl./
dialogue.zh: 我拿了牛奶和一個熱麵包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the food good here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the soup is not too salty.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə sup ɪz nɑt tu ˈsɔlti./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not run with the tray.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I walked slow, like the rule.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Find a table with room.
dialogue.zh: 找一張還有空位的桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lily saved us the round one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chew first, then talk.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I waited, then I told her more.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈweɪtɪd, ðɛn aɪ toʊld hɜr mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我嚼完了才繼續跟她聊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you finish your whole tray?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, I left the green beans.
dialogue.zh: 差不多，我留下了四季豆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time just take a few.
dialogue.zh: 下次只要拿少少的就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will ask for less food.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do the plates go?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the bin by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the table get clean?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We wiped the crumbs off together.
dialogue.zh: 我們一起把麵包屑擦掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we read in the corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I picked a book about whales.
dialogue.zh: 我選了一本關於鯨魚的書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet reading after food is best.
dialogue.zh: 吃飽後安靜閱讀最舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My eyes got heavy a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The teacher gave you a stamp?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A star for waiting in line.
dialogue.zh: 一顆星星，因為我排隊排得好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you keep your stamps?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I put it on my page.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After that you made art.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We painted a long green boat.
dialogue.zh: 我們畫了一艘長長的綠船。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was the paint water cold?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but my brush felt fine.
dialogue.zh: 涼，但我的畫筆還挺好用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did it dry by the end?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly, we left it on the rack.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli, wi lɛft ɪt ɑn ðə ræk./
dialogue.zh: 快乾了，我們把它放在晾架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now one last bell today.
dialogue.zh: 現在是今天最後一聲鈴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means my bag and the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz maɪ bæɡ ənd ðə dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am waiting at the gate.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saw you and ran out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How was your very first day?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better than I thought it would be.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər ðæn aɪ θɔt ɪt wʊd bi./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you get lost in there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just once, and I asked.
dialogue.zh: 就迷過一次，然後我問了路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me one good thing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I shared my crackers with Lily.
dialogue.zh: 我把我的餅乾分給莉莉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you tell her about bikes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her bike has a loud bell.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did you do at break?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We jumped rope, ten each.
dialogue.zh: 我們輪流跳繩，一人十下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was any part hard today?
dialogue.zh: 今天有沒有哪裡很困難？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finding my desk at first.
dialogue.zh: 剛開始找不到我的座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you fix that?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tag on it told me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You solved it by yourself.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, with a little help.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，也有別人小小的幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is still a win.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I show you my stamp?
dialogue.zh: 我可以給你看我的印章嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A star stamp, nice work.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She gave me one for waiting.
dialogue.zh: 她說那是因為我會耐心等待。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Home first, shoes come off.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My bag goes on my chair.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wash up and take a rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half an hour, then my book.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have homework day one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, read ten minutes tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reading counts as work?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She said the eyes do the work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛd ði aɪz du ðə wɜrk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which book did you pick?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The new one from reading class.
dialogue.zh: 就是閱讀課發的那本新書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit by the lamp and read.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I read it twice already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is on your chart tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have math and music.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Music means the small drums.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we share them in class.
dialogue.zh: 對，上課時我們要輪流用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write them both down now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will draw a star for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl drɔ ə stɑr fər ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hang the chart by your bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So I can see it at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ kæn si ɪt ət naɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's check what came home.
dialogue.zh: 我們看看書包帶了什麼回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll empty it on the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two papers and your snack box.
dialogue.zh: 兩張紙，還有你的零食盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The paper says sign it, please.
dialogue.zh: 那張紙寫著請家長簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will sign it tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is the pen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The new book goes back in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fits under the folder.
dialogue.zh: 它剛好塞在資料夾下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your bottle is still full.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I forgot to drink all day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fill it up for tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold water from the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set out clothes for tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gray shirt and the warm one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡreɪ ʃɜrt ənd ðə wɔrm wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 灰色上衣和那件保暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put your shoes by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're still clean enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What snack will you take?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Another apple, if that is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your face looks very tired.
dialogue.zh: 你的臉色看起來好疲倦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: School is louder than at home.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loud days make quiet nights.
dialogue.zh: 吵的日子會讓夜晚安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My legs feel like water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then into the bath right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm water, no soap in my eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ˈwɔtər, noʊ soʊp ɪn maɪ aɪz./
dialogue.zh: 水要溫的，肥皂水不要跑進眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Towel, pajamas, brush your hair.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I combed it, it feels soft.
dialogue.zh: 我梳過了，摸起來柔柔的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you brush top and bottom?
dialogue.zh: 上面的牙和下面的都刷了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All of them, I counted twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One story, then lights out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The short one, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Once upon a time, a bus.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And it was yellow and slow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It carried a new kid to school.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈkærid ə nu kɪd tu skul./
dialogue.zh: 它載了一個新生去學校。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That kid was a lot like me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt kɪd wʌz ə lɑt laɪk mi./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow the walk will feel small.
dialogue.zh: 明天這段路就會變很小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I already know where to go.
dialogue.zh: 我已經知道要往哪裡走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lily takes the bus too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll keep one seat for her.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your day is done, and good.
dialogue.zh: 你的一天結束了，過得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I did not cry at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not even at the door?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only a tiny bit, inside.
dialogue.zh: 只在教室裡面掉了一點點眼淚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That still counts as brave.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brave is a hard word to say.
dialogue.phonetic: /breɪv ɪz ə hɑrd wɜrd tu seɪ./
dialogue.zh: 勇敢這個字講起來好難。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say it soft and close your eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ɪt sɔft ənd kloʊz jʊr aɪz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I was brave today, I was brave.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʌz breɪv təˈdeɪ, aɪ wʌz breɪv./
dialogue.zh: 我今天很勇敢，我今天很勇敢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, your breathing slowed down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blanket is warm again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The alarm is set for seven.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And you will wake me first.
dialogue.zh: 而且你會第一個叫我起床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your bag stands by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Uniform on the chair, all ready.
dialogue.zh: 校服在椅子上，全準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing left to think about.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only tomorrow, and it is fine.
dialogue.zh: 只剩明天，而明天沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep now, my school kid.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, thanks for today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sweet dreams, day two will come.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And I will be ready for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd aɪ wɪl bi ˈrɛdi fər ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 而我已經準備好面對它。
